title: What If You Jumped Off an Asteroid?

scenes.text: What if you jumped off an asteroid? You might never come back down.
Bennu is an asteroid about 490 meters wide, and NASA's OSIRIS-REx spacecraft visited it.
Its escape velocity is about 20 centimeters per second. That's under half a mile an hour.
Even a gentle hop on Earth launches you many times faster than that.
The spacecraft's sampling head sank about 50 centimeters into the surface almost without resistance, like a pile of styrofoam balls.
So you'd leave the asteroid for good, or end up orbiting it. Bennu even throws off rocks up to 10 centimeters wide by itself.

description:
What if you jumped off an asteroid?
Bennu's escape velocity is only about 20 centimeters per second, so a normal jump would send you away from it.
